title: 14. The Busy Garbage Truck
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Rumble, rumble! Early in the morning, a big garbage truck slowly enters the lane. Hori's ears perk up. Wow! There's a big container on the back of that vehicle. What is it? Rumble, crunch! The busy garbage truck!
Mom, why does that truck stop in every lane? Hori asks, bouncing while holding Mom's hand. Mom smiles. It collects the garbage we put out. Kongi is here, too. Shall we take a closer look together?

At the corner where the truck has stopped, a sanitation worker in a bright vest puts garbage bags into a large wheeled bin. Hello! Have you come to learn about garbage trucks? The worker waves a gloved hand. Hori's heart goes thump, thump!

Look at this arm. It's called the grabber arm. A large metal arm reaches from the side of the truck, grips the full wheeled bin, and lifts it up! Then it empties the bin into the truck. Wow! It's so strong! Hori's mouth falls open.

When the garbage goes inside, a large metal plate rumbles and presses it flat. This is the compactor. It squeezes the garbage so the truck can carry more. Kongi's eyes grow round. Wow! Like me packing chestnuts into my cheek pouches! Rumble, crunch! The busy garbage truck!

Is all garbage the same? Hori asks. No. Cans, bottles, and paper can be used again, so we collect them separately. That's sorting for recycling. Other trucks collect recycling and food scraps on other days. Along the lane, colored bins hold cans, bottles, and paper, each in its own place.

Would Hori like to help? Hori puts an empty plastic bottle in the plastics bin, and Kongi puts a cardboard box in the paper bin. When Kongi tries to put a leftover apple in the plastics bin, Hori explains quickly. That's food waste! It needs a separate bin. Kongi smiles.

Shall we move the grabber arm? The worker holds Hori's hand, and they press the control button together. Rumble! The metal arm lifts the wheeled bin high! Hori's tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. I made the garbage truck work! Rumble, crunch! The busy garbage truck!
When the lane is clean, the truck rumbles toward the next one. The worker sweeps up even the last little scraps with a broom. Hori and Kongi wave. Thank you for keeping our neighborhood clean!

On the way home, Hori holds Mom's hand and chats. The grabber arm lifts the bin, the compactor squeezes the garbage, and we sort things for recycling! The truck and the workers keep our neighborhood clean. Hori smiles at the sky. Rumble, crunch! The busy garbage truck!
